item_short_desc: When the suck is off the charts, embrace it with Rothco’s Suck Meter Morale Patch.
description: When the suck is off the charts, embrace it with Rothco’s Suck Meter Morale Patch. Measuring 2 ½” X 1 ¼”, the suck meter patch comes in Multicam colors and features a hook back to attach to other loop gear, such as Rothco’s Special Ops Jacket, Transport Pack, and/or Tactical Vests. The suck patch is the perfect gift to give your airsoft/paintball friends.
